[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] CyrusOne is a large scale data center provider headquartered in Dallas, Texas. In 2016 CyrusOne purchased the Chicago Mercantile Exchanges original Aurora, Illinois data center from CME Group for roughly 130 million dollars, with CME Group continuing to operate its Globex matching engine on site under a 15 year lease. In November 2021, KKR and Global Infrastructure Partners agreed to acquire CyrusOne in an approximately 15 billion dollar deal, taking the company private, and that acquisition closed in 2022. CyrusOne has operated as a privately held company since, a company level ownership fact this registry had not previously recorded with a citable source. This specific row, PHX7, is one of five entries in this registry for this operators Chandler, Arizona campus on South Ellis Street. A datacentermap listing dedicated to PHX7, fetched fresh this session, gives 2705 South Ellis Street, Building 10, Chandler, Arizona 85286 as the street address. This row shares its street number with the neighboring PHX8 building but carries a distinct building number, Building 10 versus Building 9, which this session double checked via separate dedicated fetches for each to rule out a source mix up.
